title: Cobblemon Biome Tokens
description: Adds Time Based Tokens to help with rare Pokemon!
body:
Cobblemon Biome Tokens adds a gacha-inspired pity system to Cobblemon, rewarding players for spending time exploring the world and hunting Pokémon.

As you adventure through different biomes, a timer tracks your progress. Once the configured duration is reached (default: 4 hours), you'll receive a Biome Token corresponding to the biome you're currently in. Tokens can be either Rare or Ultra Rare, giving players a guaranteed way to work toward obtaining hard-to-find Pokémon and rewards without removing the excitement of rare encounters.

In addition, the mod includes a configurable shiny chance, allowing players to occasionally earn shiny rewards through the token system.

Features
- Biome-Specific Tokens – Earn tokens based on the biome you're exploring.
- Rare & Ultra Rare Tiers – Receive either a Rare Token or the more valuable Ultra Rare Token.
- Configurable Reward Timer – Default interval is 4 hours, but can be adjusted to fit your server's progression.
- Configurable Shiny Chance – Customize the odds of receiving shiny rewards.
- Pity System for Rare Hunts – Helps reduce bad luck streaks while keeping rare Pokémon valuable.
- Rewards Exploration – Different biomes offer different token opportunities, encouraging players to travel and discover new areas.
- Server-Friendly Configuration – Easily tweak rates, timers, and shiny chances to match your community's preferences.

Whether you're running a casual server, a competitive community, or a large-scale adventure world, Cobblemon Biome Tokens provides a flexible and rewarding progression system that fits seamlessly into the Cobblemon experience.

HELPFUL COMMANDS

/biometimer (shows the timer of the biome you're in) <all> <biome> <current>

DEV COMMANDS

/biometokengive
/biometokenpick
